target: Terrain diagram never renders — DEM fetch fails because the SIX Maps fallback timeout is too short
findings_summary: LIVE-probed both DEM endpoints for a Haberfield coord. GA WCS 1.0.0 returns HTTP 400 (ArcGIS Server Error HTML) in ~9.6s — endpoint is broken/deprecated; v2.0.1 also fails. SIX Maps exportImage WORKS — returns a valid 262KB GeoTIFF — but takes 26.2s, while dem_service._TIMEOUT=20 kills it first, so fetch_dem_region raises and terrain renders an 'unavailable' card with no diagram. The brief calls _fetch_terrain with include_flood=False, so only ONE fetch_dem_region(500m) runs per brief; total ~45s (GA fail ~19s + SIX ~26s) fits the 55s brief terrain budget once SIX Maps gets enough time. Fix: raise _TIMEOUT to 40 (SIX needs ~26s) and cap GA WCS at min(timeout,12)s so the broken primary can't eat the budget. No DB/schema/spatial change.
